newsitem.title: UK: Mexico cuts Mar Isthmus crude price to Europe/U.S..
newsitem.headline: Mexico cuts Mar Isthmus crude price to Europe/U.S..

text.p: Mexico has cut the price of its Isthmus crude loading in March for U.S. and European customers but left Maya unchanged, traders said on Thursday.
Isthmus to Europe was priced at Pemex formula less 26 cents a barrel, 10 cents down on February and at formula less $1.15 a barrel to the U.S., representing a cut of 15 cents, they said.
March Maya crude was left unchanged at Pemex formula less $1.85 a barrel and formula less $1.75 a barrel to Europe and the U.S. respectively.
Olmeca to U.S. customers was cut by 15 cents in March to formula plus 40 cents, the traders said.
On Wednesday, traders said Mexico also cut the price of Maya and Isthmus crude to Asia by 10 and 15 cents respectively.
